title: Credit Ratings and the Hold-Up Problem in the Loan Market
eligible_reason: Single reform date: the Banque de France rating reform in 2004Q2 (policy_time = quarter - 2004q2; rating_surprise = treat x after). Treated firms receive a rating surprise at the common reform date. Two-group, one-date design. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: CR_analysis.do: reghdfe D_tot_A rating_surprise, a(siren IND#REG#treat_group#policy_time) vce(cl siren) and variants with fewer FE, heterogeneity interactions, and a relative-quarter event study (treat_172-treat_180). CR_analysis_branch.do firm-bank level; BS_analysis.do firm-year balance-sheet outcomes.
data_access: proprietary (Banque de France data via CASD secure access on request)
data_files_note: readme.pdf: data are proprietary and under NDA; access via CASD. The folder also contains an unrelated nested archive mnsc.2023.4777.zip and its extracted package (MS-OPM-19-01547), which should be ignored for this paper.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Note for lead: ~/did_packages/mnsc/mnsc.2023.4779 also contains mnsc.2023.4777.zip and an extracted mnsc.2023.4777/ folder (a different paper, MS-OPM-19-01547); not used here.
